target_moa.text: Vanzacaftor and tezacaftor are CFTR correctors that bind different sites on the CFTR protein with additive effect to facilitate cellular processing and trafficking of mutant CFTR to the cell surface; deutivacaftor is a CFTR potentiator that increases channel open probability (gating).

citations.quote: Vanzacaftor and tezacaftor bind to different sites on the CFTR protein and have an additive effect in facilitating the cellular processing and trafficking of select mutant forms of CFTR (including *F508del*-CFTR) to increase the amount of CFTR protein delivered to the cell surface compared to either molecule alone. Deutivacaftor potentiates the channel open probability (or gating) of the CFTR prot

modality.text: Small molecule (oral fixed-dose combination of three CFTR modulators).

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥5% and ≥1% higher than ELX/TEZ/IVA): cough (25% vs 24%), nasopharyngitis (21% vs 19%), upper respiratory tract infection (21% vs 20%), headache (16% vs 13%), oropharyngeal pain (14% vs 12%), influenza (11% vs 5%), fatigue (11% vs 9%), increased ALT (8% vs 6%), rash (8% vs 4%), increased AST (7% vs 5%), sinus congestion (7% vs 3%). Serious risk is drug-induced liver injury and liver failure.

description.text: Expanded CF indication to add 280 ultra-rare CFTR variants responsive based on clinical/in vitro data or resulting in CFTR protein production

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for an expansion of the indication of Alyftrek (VNZ/TEZ/D-IVA) tablets for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in adult and pediatric patients aged 6 years and older who have a clinical diagnosis of CF and who have at least one variant in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) gene that is either responsive based on clinical and/or in vitro data or results in production of CFTR protein. This indication expansion is based on 280 ultra-rare CFTR variants included in Section 12 of the Prescribing Information.
